assessment.classification: SHOWN exact closed branch and adversarial tests
assessment.subject: Narrow verifier extension
assessment.detail: The marker is permitted only in the market slot, with exactly five fields, explicit single-cited-query-v1 in raw and assistant status, latest_price exactly None and type(window_samples) exactly int. Unchanged surrounding guards require literal ok=False and zero numeric change/samples, excluding booleans. Integer-zero samples follows from the int test plus retained numeric-zero guard. Snapshot-location markers, extra/missing fields, null substitutes such as latest_price=0, available/numeric ok, floats/bools for samples and bad/missing protocols refuse.
